placement_scope: pair-local communicator groups within each parent
methodology: One single-variable network ABBA at 25 MiB FP32 per rank. Every GPU is in a disjoint eight-rank four-plus-four communicator. Expand only after both CPUs' independent gates, true numerical data and channel markers pass on all four pilot pairs, and median Socket/SHCA >= 2 per pilot pair. Concurrent wave is a new contention condition.
out_of_scope: No cross-parent communicator, no rerun of failed default-Socket pair, no borrowed nodes with protected foreign KFD, no framework default route change, no model or throughput acceptance.
